messages.text: What can I do to get a refund?

The order must first be delivered, and the shop must receive the item back before you can request a refund. Refund requests must also be made within 30 days of the recorded delivery time. (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders) (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/window)
